messages:
Maria Chen: Kicking off the MerchantPilot POC scoping thread — main asks: define success criteria for the eval harness, finalize golden prompt set, scoring rubric, and a two-week timeline. Need alignment by EOD Friday.

AJ Patel: Quick context — customer wants purchase-recommendation and refund-assistant flows. Traffic ~200 req/s peak, latency target 300ms p95, and they care about hallucination rate.

Sofie Larsson: For the golden set I propose: 200 user queries (100 recs, 100 refunds) with blind human judgments. Keep a 20% adversarial subset. Anonymize PII before we ingest.

Ken O'Malley: +1 on adversarial subset. Also: include 50 multi-turn sessions to test KV cache correctness and state.

Laura Gomez: Security note: customer data requires our DPA + encrypted staging buckets. Security Bot, can we use synthetic data instead for goldens?

Security Bot: short answer: synthetic OK if representative. If using customer dumps we need an approved data handling attestation and KMS keys. Send questionnaire Q3 & Q7 to Legal.

AJ Patel: Scoring rubric proposal (draft):
```
- Intent accuracy (binary) -> 50%
- Response fidelity (human rating 1-5 normalized) -> 30%
- Latency penalty (p95) -> 10%
- Hallucination/ factual errors (count per 100 responses) -> 10% lower-is-better
Pass threshold: composite >= 0.88
```

Maria Chen: Example prompt/expected pattern for recs (for dataset):
```
User: "Looking for a gift for a 30yo who likes cycling and coffee"
Expected: 3 items sorted by relevance, at least one under $50, include concise rationale (<=2 sentences)
```

Sofie Larsson: For automatic scoring we should use embedding similarity for relevance + human spot checks for rationale quality. I'll prep an eval runner in the harness using cosine > 0.78 as match.

Ken O'Malley: Regression gate idea: on any model or quant change, run full harness; block rollout if composite score drops by > 0.02 absolute or latency p95 increases > 10%.

AJ Patel: Pricing/infra question from customer: do we need Dedicated to hit 300ms p95 at 200 req/s? Ops: rough T-shirt: yes for smallest models; for larger ones likely Dedicated with reserved GPUs. Ballpark incremental cost estimate needed for contract.

Laura Gomez: I'll capture cost ballpark: estimate monthly reserved GPU+support delta -> send to AJ by tomorrow. Also note: if they want private deployment, procurement timeline + security review add 3-4 weeks.

Maria Chen: Timeline proposal: Week 0 (this week) finalize goldens + data handling; Week 1 run baseline models and calibrate scorer; Week 2 run stress + regression and produce acceptance report. Go/no-go end of Week 2.

Presales Bot: Reminder: attach the POC SOW template to this thread and include the acceptance gates section.

Sofie Larsson: I'll build the initial golden set CSV (fields: id, flow, prompt, expected, anonymized_context, tags) and push to the harness repo. Owner: Sofie. ETA: Thu EOD.

Ken O'Malley: I'll add CI job: /ci/eval-harness/merchant-pilot that runs on model push and reports to rollout dashboard. Owner: Ken. ETA: next Wed.

AJ Patel: Who's owning the human labeling for rationale quality? We need 2 reviewers per item, conflict resolution rules.

Maria Chen: Laura to own labeling procurement and QA process. Laura: can you confirm vendor or internal ops?

Laura Gomez: We can do internal for first 200 items. I'll recruit ops and set up the labeling doc. ETA Fri.

Maria Chen: Security Bot flagged Q3/Q7 to Legal — Laura pls follow up. If legal requires, swap to synthetic.

AJ Patel: Final ask: include a simple scoring example in harness README and a reproducible notebook for customer demos. Sofie, can you do the notebook?

Sofie Larsson: Yep — I'll add a notebook that runs 20 sample queries and shows scorer breakdown. ETA Mon.

Maria Chen: Great. Action items recap in thread:
- Sofie: goldens CSV + notebook (Thu EOD / Mon sample)
- Ken: CI eval job (next Wed)
- Laura: labeling + legal follow-up + cost ballpark (Fri / tomorrow)
- AJ: coordinate with customer on Dedicated vs hosted decision and requirements
- Maria: finalize acceptance gates doc and SOW section (EOD Fri)

Maria Chen: If no objections I'll lock these and queue a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00 to confirm. :thumbsup:

AJ Patel: :thumbsup: works for me.

Ken O'Malley: :+1: I'll be there.

Laura Gomez: On calendar.

Presales Bot: SOW template attached (link) — please customize the acceptance_gates block.
